name: @lnwjud/desktop
description: Windows-first local AI-agent runtime and MCP gateway with 208 tools.
author: Adisorn

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && vite build --config vite.config.ts && esbuild ../cli/src/bin/mcp-stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=build/lnwjud-mcp-stdio.cjs && node scripts/write-stdio-launcher.mjs
scripts.build:main: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js
scripts.package:windows: corepack pnpm@10.15.0 build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.test:e2e: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --banner:js="import { createRequire as __lnwjudCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __lnwjudCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/main/main.js && vite build --config vite.config.ts && playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
